title: Laws of Reflection
guideExplore: Move the incidence angle slider — watch the reflected ray match the incident angle.
guideGrazing: Grazing angle: light skims the mirror — both angles stay large and equal.
guideNearNormal: Near-normal: light hits almost straight on — small equal angles.
conditionsHint: Law of reflection: angle of incidence equals angle of reflection (∠i = ∠r).
learnMore: When light reflects from a smooth surface, the angle it makes with the normal (∠i) equals the reflected angle (∠r).
